prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Screen After Adoption: Reorder onboarding so users choose and customize their pet before signing in to their account. (why: Sign_in drops 27.1% of users with a high mean time of 567s before users experience pet creation value.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Mascot Quick Reference Cheatsheet: Add a new cheatsheet screen before completing onboarding that highlights desktop controls, hotkeys, and hide commands. (why: Support receives multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after setup.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Step Pet Customization Studio: Redesign pick_friend into a split-screen interactive Studio view with live trait selection and mascot preview. (why: Adoption has a 68.7% conversion rate and a high mean time of 1017s, plus support issues regarding custom pet rendering.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Cloud Pet Recovery Notice: Display a prominent hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that logging into an existing account restores saved pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Renderer Diagnostic Status Timer: Add explicit rendering stage progress and diagnostic helper status to the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step mean time is 2336s and 3 support emails reported pets failing to render on desktop.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Express vs Custom Copy: Clarify the distinction between instant preset adoption and photo-based custom pet creation in choose_path copy. (why: The choose_path mean time is 514s, showing users hesitate while deciding which path to take.)
6: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Layout Grid: Reformat the adoption certificate screen into a clear grid layout with prominent verification details. (why: Adoption drops over 31% of users with an average duration over 16 minutes.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Audio Notification Alert: Add an audio alert notification component when waiting finishes and the desktop pet spawns. (why: The median time in home/waiting is 201s and mean is 2336s, indicating users minimize or walk away during rendering.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in after value creation addresses a major 27.1% drop at sign_in.
Adds a new reference screen at finish step; strongly supported by user tickets.
Interactive studio redesign targets a 31.3% adoption drop and rendering issues.
Low-cost hint directly addressing 8 support emails regarding cloud pet recovery.
Diagnostic timer directly addresses rendering support tickets and long wait times.
Config copy change resolving user hesitation (514s mean time) at path selection.
Layout reformat aiming to reduce the 31.3% drop off during adoption.
Audio alert re-engages users leaving during long desktop render wait times.
